title: TED Student Talks
description: Led members of the TED-Ed club at DBIS alongside co-leads and mentors to guide diverse student talks through a rigorous process while discovering a new passion for Mathematics.
details: Led and guided members of the TED-Ed club at DBIS alongside Riaan Rao and Arnav Daftari, helping students with diverse interests push through a rigorous process and deliver their talks.
Worked closely with mentors Ms. Aarti Malik and Ms. Adelle Almeida to stay on track amid tight schedules and exams while iterating on feedback step by step.
Key takeaway: the experience sparked an unexpected admiration for Mathematics that shaped my direction for my Mathematics extended essay.

title: uMatter
description: A safe space for students to reflect, connect, and grow.
details: uMatter is a judgment-free digital platform designed to break the stigma around school counseling and help students reflect, learn, and reach out without fear.

Built over 5 months with psychiatrists, student surveys, and ethical reviews, the front end is structured into three pillars: Learn (credible resources), Tools (habit and productivity support), and Reach Out (discreet counselor access and the Salus chatbot).
Key achievements: impacted nearly 500 students, gained attention across Mumbai schools, and presented directly to the Education Inspector of South Mumbai.
